_readme: The 'seeders' array per environment is descriptive metadata only (a manifest of what's expected to exist in src/database/seeders/). `npm run seed:prod` always auto-discovers and runs every seeder file found there, sequentially, regardless of this list. Only 'enabled'/'autoSeed' are actually consumed by scripts/Deploy-Backend.ps1 to decide whether to run seed:prod at all. See .deployment/SEEDING.md for the safety convention on what may live in that directory.

dev.reason: Develop environment auto-seeds essential data (roles) via seed:prod. Developers needing sample data should use a manual, non-auto-discovered script instead of adding it to src/database/seeders/.

qa.reason: QA environment seeds only essential roles via seed:prod. QA team creates test data via API/UI for realistic testing.
qa.notes: Avoid pre-seeded students/classes to ensure QA tests data creation workflows

prod.reason: Production environment seeds ONLY essential roles via seed:prod. All production data must be created via proper admin workflows.
warnings: DO NOT use truncate on production
seed:prod runs every seeder file in src/database/seeders/ unconditionally — never add a sample/demo-data seeder to that directory
